lib.description: Specify library files to be included in the compilation

allowJs.description: Allow JavaScript files to be compiled

declarationMap.description: Generate a sourcemap for each corresponding .d.ts file

outFile.description: Concatenate and emit output to single file

outDir.description: Redirect output structure to the directory

rootDir.description: Specify the root directory of input files

tsBuildInfoFile.description: Specify file to store incremental compilation information

downlevelIteration.description: Provide full support for iterables in for-of, spread, and destructuring when targeting ES5 or ES3

isolatedModules.description: Transpile each file as a separate module

noImplicitAny.description: Raise error on expressions and declarations with an implied 'any' type

strictFunctionTypes.description: Enable strict checking of function types

strictBindCallApply.description: Enable strict 'bind', 'call', and 'apply' methods on functions

strictPropertyInitialization.description: Enable strict checking of property initialization in classes

noImplicitThis.description: Raise error on 'this' expressions with an implied 'any' type

alwaysStrict.description: Parse in strict mode and emit 'use strict' for each source file

noImplicitReturns.description: Report error when not all code paths in function return a value

noFallthroughCasesInSwitch.description: Report errors for fallthrough cases in switch statement

noImplicitOverride.description: Require explicit 'override' modifier for overridden methods

exactOptionalPropertyTypes.description: Interpret optional property types as written, rather than adding undefined

noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature.description: Require undeclared properties from index signatures to use element accesses

baseUrl.description: Base directory to resolve non-absolute module names

paths.description: A series of entries which re-map imports to lookup locations relative to the 'baseUrl'

rootDirs.description: List of root folders whose combined content represents the structure of the project at runtime

typeRoots.description: List of folders to include type definitions from

types.description: Type declaration files to be included in compilation

allowSyntheticDefaultImports.description: Allow default imports from modules with no default export

esModuleInterop.description: Enables emit interoperability between CommonJS and ES Modules

preserveSymlinks.description: Do not resolve the real path of symlinks

allowUmdGlobalAccess.description: Allow accessing UMD globals from modules

sourceRoot.description: Specify the location where debugger should locate TypeScript files instead of source locations

mapRoot.description: Specify the location where debugger should locate map files instead of generated locations

inlineSourceMap.description: Emit a single file with source maps instead of having a separate file

inlineSources.description: Emit the source alongside the sourcemaps within a single file

experimentalDecorators.description: Enables experimental support for ES7 decorators

emitDecoratorMetadata.description: Enables experimental support for emitting type metadata for decorators

skipLibCheck.description: Skip type checking of declaration files

forceConsistentCasingInFileNames.description: Disallow inconsistently-cased references to the same file

useDefineForClassFields.description: Use ECMAScript-standard semantics for class fields

verbatimModuleSyntax.description: Do not transform or elide any imports or exports not marked as type-only

allowImportingTsExtensions.description: Allow imports to include TypeScript file extensions

noEmitOnError.description: Do not emit outputs if any errors were reported

preserveConstEnums.description: Do not erase const enum declarations in generated code

declarationDir.description: Output directory for generated declaration files

assumeChangesOnlyAffectDirectDependencie.description: Have recompiles in incremental and watch assume that changes within a file will only affect files directly depending on it

files.description: List of files to be included in the compilation

include.description: List of glob patterns to include in the compilation

exclude.description: List of glob patterns to exclude from the compilation

extends.description: Path to another config file to inherit from

prepend.description: Prepend the output of this project to the output of the current project

include.description: List of type definitions to include

exclude.description: List of type definitions to exclude

fallbackPolling.description: Fallback polling strategy when file system events are not available

excludeDirectories.description: List of directories to exclude from watching

excludeFiles.description: List of files to exclude from watching

watchOptions.description: Watch options for file system watching
